name: dabboos-restaurant
description: DABBOOS (مطعم دبوس) — Luxury Awwwards-style Interactive Restaurant Website

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); http.createServer((req, res) => { let fp = path.join(__dirname, req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url); fs.readFile(fp, (e, d) => { if (e) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } else { res.writeHead(200); res.end(d); } }); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('DABBOOS live at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Elite Creative Frontend Developer
